identification: old stūpa and pillar at Bakror, E bank of the Nairañjanā 1 mile SE of Gayā (sic), after Cunningham
others_reported: Cunningham: Bakror
quote: 據康寧哈姆考定,今印度加雅城東南一英里尼連禪河東岸 Bakror猶存古塔及石柱,或謂玄奘所述的
note: Ji gives Cunningham's view hedged ('或謂'); agrees with Mizutani (Bakror). No post-1971 evidence.

identification: upper course of the Pewar river (after Cunningham's survey)
others_reported: Julien: Mahi; Cunningham: Mohana-nadī, = upper Pewar river; Watters: mahā 'great', proper or common noun
quote: 瓦特斯認為莫訶應還原作mahā…據康寧哈姆實測,推定為今柏瓦爾河(Pewar R.)上流
note: Differs slightly from Mizutani (Mohana river): Ji names the Pewar river. No post-1971 evidence.

name_zh: 屈屈吒播陀山 (窶盧播陀山)
identification: three peaks c. 1 mile N of Kurkihār, 16 miles NE of Gayā (Cunningham)
others_reported: Stein: Sobhnāth, highest peak of the hills SW of Kurkihār, c. 4 miles from Wazirganj; Cunningham: three peaks 1 mile N of Kurkihār
quote: 斯坦因認為是指距瓦塞爾甘潔(Wazirganj)…康寧哈姆比定爲加雅城東北十六英里處,庫爾基…我們贊同康氏意見,該山不僅…附近還發掘出不少佛像及窣堵波遗址
note: Ji sides with Cunningham against Stein, citing the three-peak shape and Buddha images and stūpa remains found nearby (no date). Same as Mizutani.

identification: Buddhain hill, NE of Kukkuṭapāda
quote: 在雞足山東北,現今的佛陀因山(Buddhain)
note: Differs from Mizutani (no accepted identification). No source cited.

identification: Jeshtiban
quote: 《慈恩傳》卷四稱此林杖林,即現今的Jeshtiban
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: hot springs at Tapoban
others_reported: Cunningham AGI p. 528: Tapoban
quote: 根據玄奘所載方位距離,今印度尚有稱作 Tapoban的温泉,疑卽其地
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_zh: 矩奢掲羅補羅城 (上茅宮城)
identification: Old Rājagṛha, the hill-ringed site at Rajgir
others_reported: five hills: Vaibhāra (= Xuanzang's Vipula), Saptaparṇaguhā (Sonagiri), Indraśailaguhā (Giriyek), Vipula, Gṛdhrakūṭa
quote: 上茅宫城卽舊王舍城,因處於羣山中,又名…王舍城遺址現名 Rajgir,爲巴特那地方的一個羣山環繞的
note: Same as Mizutani. Ji's list of the five hills makes Vaibhāra 'Xuanzang's Vipula' (contrast its undecided note at 09.02.11).

name_zh: 時縛迦說法堂 (菴婆羅園)
identification: excavated remains beside the present east gate of the city
others_reported: Faxian: in the NE corner of the city
quote: 城東北角曲中,耆舊(耆婆)於婆羅園中起精舍…其遺址經考古發掘,在今城東門傍
note: Same as Mizutani; excavation undated.

identification: doubts Cunningham's Śailagiri, as no caves are found there; gives no identification of its own
others_reported: Cunningham: Śailagiri
quote: 康寧哈姆根據實測,推定為現今Sailagiri, 但此說不無可疑之處。法顯、玄奘均記載靈鷲山有石窟不少,但 Sailagiri 山現今却無任何石窟可尋
note: Differs from Mizutani, who takes the peak as extant and identified. No post-1971 evidence.

identification: Ānanda's cave (Faxian's 鵰鷲窟) still extant on Gṛdhrakūṭa
others_reported: Faxian: bird marks and hand hole still there
quote: 鳥跡手孔今悉在,故曰鵰鷲窟。”今猶存其遺跡
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: undecided between Vaibhāra (Baibhār) W of the city and Vipula NE of it
others_reported: some: Vaibhāra (Baibhār); others: Vipula (better phonetically but against 山城北門西)
quote: 有人認爲指王舍城外西面的Vaibhara(Baibhār)…也有人認為是城東北的 Vipula 山,這一說法雖在對音上更吻合,但與玄奘所記的方向“山城北門西”相矛盾。以上二說,未知就是
note: Differs from Mizutani (Vipula hill). Inconsistent with Ji's own note on p. 719, which calls Vaibhāra Xuanzang's Vipula.

identification: cave on the N face of Vaibhāra hill, an old gold-mine working; the Pippala chamber perhaps built in front of it, the asura palace perhaps the shaft
others_reported: 印度佛跡實寫 (Takakusu) p. 18; Faxian: 賓波羅窟
quote: 山城北門之西為鞞婆羅山,由山的北面向西進,北面臨澗,有一洞穴,是古代金礦遺址。玄奘稱為卑鉢羅石室的,或建築於洞穴之前,阿素洛宫或即指此鑛坑
note: Same as Mizutani (both follow 印度佛跡實寫).

identification: = Faxian's Devadatta cave, 3 li E of the old city's N gate; no modern site named
others_reported: Faxian: 調達石窟
quote: 出舊城北,東下三里,有調達石窟
note: Same as Mizutani's equation; Ji adds nothing on the site.

name_in_source: Skt./Pa. Kalandaka; Skt. Veṇuvana, Pa. Veḷuvana
identification: names only; no site identification
quote: 竹園,梵文Venuvana,巴利文 Veluvana。此園迦蘭初與尼外道
note: Mizutani locates it outside the old N gate; Ji does not.

name_in_source: Skt. Dakṣiṇagiri; Pa. Sattapaṇṇaguhā, Skt. Saptaparṇaguhā; Faxian 車帝石室
identification: Saptaparṇa cave on the N side of Vaibhāra hill, S of Rājagṛha
others_reported: Faxian: 車帝石室
quote: 指王舍城南現今之鞞婆羅(Vaibhara)山。其北沿即下句中所提到的舉行第一次結集的石室,卽七葉窟
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: pond near the Veṇuvana, with a hot spring
others_reported: 印度佛跡實寫 p. 18
quote: 即迦蘭陁竹園附近的池塘,此間有溫泉
note: Same as Mizutani in substance; no local name (Mizutani: Manavasar).

name_zh: 無憂王堵波・石柱 (迦蘭陀池西北)
identification: stūpa and pillar NW of the pond confirmed by excavation (no site named)
others_reported: 印度佛跡實寫 p. 18
quote: 所見的窣堵波和石柱,近代考古發掘業已證實
note: Mizutani: probably near Baitarni Godan; Ji names no place. Excavation undated.

name_zh: 曷羅闍姞利呬城 (王舍城)
identification: New Rājagṛha, N of the five hills, c. 4 li from the old city
quote: 此指王舍新城。一說此城為與佛陀同時代的摩揭陁國頻毗娑羅王所建…新城在環繞舊城的五山之北,距舊城約四里…近代考古學界曾在王舍城進行過發掘,但收獲不大
note: Same as Mizutani. Ji notes excavations yielded mostly Jaina material (undated).

identification: Nālandā ruins at Baragaon village, 7 miles NW of Rājgir (Cunningham 1861; excavated from 1915)
others_reported: Cunningham: Baragaon; Raychaudhuri 1953, Ghosh 1950, Hirananda Sastri (MASI 66) on dating and finds
quote: 西北七英里處的巴羅貢(Baragoan)村…1861年康寧哈姆發現該遺址後,只進行了少量發掘工作…其中究竟哪一部分是玄奘所記載的六個伽藍,目前還無法確定
note: Same as Mizutani. Ji: which excavated monasteries are Xuanzang's six cannot be decided; mentions the 1950s Xuanzang memorial hall. No post-1971 evidence.

name_zh: 精舍 (如來三月說法處, 那爛陀伽藍西)
identification: = Yijing's Mūlagandhakuṭī, the Buddha's rains-retreat place
others_reported: Yijing: 慕攞健陀俱胝
quote: 是世尊昔日夏三月安居處,梵名慕攞健陀俱胝,唐云根本香殿矣
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: a 5th-century standing Avalokiteśvara found near Site 12 at Nālandā; whether it is Xuanzang's image remains to be settled
others_reported: 高田修 印度南海の仏教美術 p. 104
quote: 在那爛陀寺遺址的第十二號塔院附近發現五世紀製作的觀自在立像…但此像是否卽玄奘所記載的立像,尚待考定
note: Not in Mizutani. Takata's book is pre-1971.

identification: Jagdishpur
quote: 拘理迦,梵文 Kolika,又譯拘離迦…此地即現今 Jagdishpur
note: Differs from Mizutani (no modern identification). No source cited.

identification: = Faxian's Nāla village, Śāriputra's birthplace; now Sarichak
others_reported: H. Sastri: Mahāvastu Nālandāgrāmaka, i.e. another name of Nālandā
quote: 舍利弗本生地,那羅聚落的别名…據考證此地現今 Sarichak…舍利弗生地爲 Nālandāgrāmaka
note: Differs from Mizutani by adding a modern site (Sarichak); Mizutani has the Nāla equation only.

identification: Giriyek hill, 6 miles E of Rājagṛha, = Faxian's small isolated rock hill (Cunningham), but left open because Faxian's distance differs
others_reported: Cunningham: Giriyek
quote: 康寧哈姆比定為王舍城東六英里的吉里也克山(Giriyek),即《法顯傳》中的小孤石山…但法顯所記距離與玄奘相差頗遠。此說待考
note: Differs in stance from Mizutani, who accepts Giriyek.

identification: Bihār (Bihar Sharif), reading 五六十里 for 百五六十里
quote: 今考定在Bihār,似以北行五六十里爲當
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: undecided
others_reported: Julien: Rohinila; Watters: Lavananila; Cunningham: Rajjāna
quote: 名為Rohinila; 瓦特斯據宋本作般,還原為Lavanila…康寧哈姆比定爲 Rajjāna。目前頗難確定其是非
note: Same as Mizutani (unsettled); Ji adds Cunningham's Rajjāna.

identification: Monghyr (Bihar); territory Lakhisarai to Sultanganj
others_reported: Julien: Hiraṇyaparvata; Watters: Iraṇaparvata
quote: 瓦特斯不同意此說,認為應爲 Iranaparvata…該國地望多數學者一致認為卽今印度比哈爾邦的孟格爾(Monghyr)
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Pirpahar hill, 3 miles E of Monghyr
others_reported: 'recent scholars'
quote: 近人考定 Monghyr 以東三英里處的Pirpahar 山…表明是一座活火山
note: Same as Mizutani. Ji takes the smoke as a sign of volcanic activity and cites the hot springs and the January 1934 earthquake.

identification: Uren hill, 20 miles SW of Monghyr, 7 miles S of the Ganges (Waddell)
others_reported: Cunningham: Mahadeva hill; Waddell: Uren (Majumdar's note in Cunningham AGI p. 722)
quote: 康寧哈姆比定此山爲一個稱爲“大天”(Mahadeva)的丘陵,後瓦德爾(Wadell)提出異議,認為此山是孟格爾西南二十英里,恒河南岸七英里處的烏爛(Uren)山。該處曾發掘出佛像,碑文及佛寺遺址等
note: Same as Mizutani (Uren).

identification: Campā, between the villages Campānagara and Campāpuri near Bhagalpur
quote: 該城遺址至今尚存,在巴迦爾普爾(Bhagalpur)附近的Campānagara 及 Campāpuri 兩村之間
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Kajughira (Julien); Kajunghira = Pa. Kajaṅgala; popular name Kayaṅgala
identification: Rājmahal, formerly Kankjol (old town 18 miles S of Rājmahal, extant)
others_reported: Cunningham: Rājmahal/Kankjol
quote: 考定為現今拉吉馬哈爾(Rājmahal),原名 Kankjol(古城在拉吉馬哈爾以南十八英里,至今尚存)…故此羯朱嗢祇羅郎 Kajangala。其今地也與玄奘所記基本相合
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Rajshahi and Bogra region; capital Mahāsthāngarh, 7 miles N of Bogra
others_reported: Cunningham: Pabna; Fergusson: Rangpur; B.C. Law: Rajshahi and Bogra
quote: 學者勞(BC.Law)考定爲在今孟加拉國 Rajshahi 及 Bogra 一帶…Bogra 位置與上述記載均相符合,勞的看法是對的…國都遺址在今 Bogra 城以北七英里處的摩
note: Same as Mizutani (Mizutani: 8 miles). Cites the Xin Tangshu itinerary and N. Ahmed's Mahasthan excavation report (undated in Ji).

identification: ruins between Bihar and Vasu-Bihar villages, 4 miles NW of Mahāsthān (Gupta finds)
others_reported: L. Joshi: bhasuā; N. Ahmed p. 62
quote: 此寺遺址在上述摩訶斯坦城西北四英里,Bihar 及 Vasu-Bihar 兩村之間…該地曾發掘出土笈多王朝時代的文物不少
note: Same as Mizutani; Ji adds that the Aśoka stūpa and the Avalokiteśvara vihāra have traces (after Ahmed).

identification: W Assam; capital Prāgjyotiṣa/Kāmākhyā at Gauhati
others_reported: B.C. Law HGAI pp. 251-253; B.K. Barua, Cultural History of Assam
quote: 在今印度阿薩姆(Assam)邦的西部…城,在今阿薩姆邦高哈提(Gauhati
note: Same as Mizutani. Ji says Śaiva temple sites of Xuanzang's time have been excavated (after Barua, pre-1971).

identification: the Brahmaputra or its lower course, the Jamuna
others_reported: others: the Karatoyā (迦羅都河) of the Xin Tangshu
quote: 指雅魯藏布江下游布拉瑪普特拉河…或其下段賈納河。也有人認為是指《新唐書》中所提到的迦羅都河
note: Not in Mizutani's list (added place).

identification: Ganges–Meghna delta (Tipperah, Noakhali, Sylhet); capital Karmānta = Bad-Kamta, 12 miles W of Comilla
others_reported: Cunningham: Jessore; Fergusson: Sonargaon; Watters: Faridpur; B.C. Law: Bad-Kamta
quote: 一般比定此國都爲卡爾曼塔(Karmanta),在今孟加拉國達卡西南的柯密拉(Gomilla)…以西十二英里處的巴德·迦姆答
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Thare Khettara near Prome on the Irrawaddy, Lower Burma; Xuanzang's 'NE' should be 'SE'
others_reported: P. Bhattacharya (JRAS 1920): the six are local (Sylhet etc.); Finot (JRAS 1920) refuted him, Ji agrees with Finot
quote: 卽緬甸故都 Thare Khettara,在今下緬甸伊洛瓦底江畔蔑(Prome)附近…實際上他所列舉的前三處都在三摩呾吒境内
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Skt. Kāmalaṅkā; 狼牙修, 郎迦戍 Laṅkasu
identification: Langkasuka on the Malay Peninsula (Patani, Kedah or Tenasserim)
others_reported: views: Patani; Kedah; Tenasserim (梁書 頓遜); Bhattacharya: Comilla
quote: 卽《梁書》卷五四中的狼牙修,《南海寄歸內法傳》卷一和《大唐西域求法高僧傳》中的郎迦戍(Lankasu),在馬來半島上
note: Differs from Mizutani (Pegu and the Irrawaddy delta).

name_in_source: Skt. Dvārapati; 杜和鉢底, 墮和羅, 獨和羅
identification: Ayutthaya, old capital of Siam (its Sanskrit name)
others_reported: Bhattacharya: Tipperah
quote: 中的社和鉢底,《舊唐書》中的墮和羅,《新唐書》中的獨和羅,卽泰國古都 Ayuthya 或 Ayudhya 的梵文名稱
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Cambodia (Zhenla; capital 伊奢那城)
others_reported: Bhattacharya: Manipur
quote: 伊賞那補羅,梵文 Iśanapura 音譯,即柬埔寨故名
note: Same as Mizutani (Mizutani adds Sambor Prei Kuk).

name_in_source: Skt. Mahācampā; 林邑, 環王國
identification: Champa, SE coast of Indochina
others_reported: Bhattacharya: Bhamo
quote: 亦作林邑、環王國,卽占婆,位于印度支那半島的東南海岸
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Skt. Yamanadvīpa or Yavanadvīpa; Faxian 耶婆提
identification: Java
others_reported: others: Sumatra; Bhattacharya: Tambudeepa S of Ava
quote: 傳》作耶婆提,卽爪哇,有人認為指今蘇門答臘
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Skt. Tāmralipti, Pa. Tāmalitti; Ptolemy Tamalites
identification: Tamluk, Midnapur district, W Bengal
others_reported: Fergusson: Satgaon; Lal Gupta (JBTS v) settled Tamluk
quote: 其地望據訂在今印度西孟加拉邦米德納浦爾縣(Midnapur)的塔姆魯克(Tamluk)…(Lal Gupta)詳盡地研究過躭摩栗底的古代歷史與塔姆魯克的沿之後,各種争議遂告平息
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Rajbadidanga, Murshidabad district, W Bengal, where a seal of Śrī Raktamṛttikā Mahāvihāra was found; the country lies NE (not NW) of Tāmralipti
others_reported: B.P. Sinha, Archaeology and Art of India (Delhi 1979) p. 6
quote: 近年來考古發掘的結果,一般認為其地在今印度西孟加拉邦穆爾昔達巴德(Murshidabad)縣的羅杰巴底登迦(Rajbadidanga)。該地曾出土刻有“吉祥赤泥大寺”(Sri Raktamrttikamahāvihāra)銘文的封泥
note: Post-1971: the Rajbadidanga excavations and the Raktamṛttikā seal, via Sinha 1979. Agrees with Mizutani's Rāṅgāmāṭi area but names the excavated site. Ji also argues the juan's country order and the 'NW' bearing are Bianji's rearrangement (Life itinerary).

identification: the Raktamṛttikā monastery at Rajbadidanga (by reference to the country note's seal)
quote: 意譯赤泥,由於此地泥土呈赤色,故名
note: Same place as Mizutani's Rāṅgāmāṭi, now tied to the excavated site; see 10.08.

identification: N Orissa; capital at Dhauli (ancient Tosali), 7 miles S of Bhubaneswar (Takakuwa)
others_reported: Cunningham: Cuttack; Fergusson: Midnapur; Watters: Jajpur; Takakuwa: Dhauli/Tosali
quote: 再後高桑駒吉考訂為布巴斯瓦爾(Bhubaneswar) 以南七英里處武里(Dhauli)村…并是如來說法之處,無王之所建也”。高桑氏的考證是對的
note: Differs from Mizutani (capital undecided). Ji endorses Takakuwa's Dhauli on the strength of the Aśokan edicts.

identification: Khandagiri, at Khurda c. 4 miles W of Bhubaneswar (Cunningham); the caves were originally Buddhist
others_reported: Cunningham: Khandagiri; ASR 1902-3; Imperial Gazetteer XV
quote: 據康寧哈姆考訂,在今布巴涅斯瓦爾市以西約四英里的庫爾德(Khurdà)地方的坎德山(Khandagiri)…學者們大都認為這些洞窟原係佛教寺院
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Udayagiri (Bhubaneswar)
others_reported: Cunningham
quote: 下述“西北山”印烏陀耶山(Udayagiri)
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: undecided between Puri and Nendra on the old Mahānadī bed
others_reported: Cunningham: Puri; Waddell: Nendra village, 15 miles below Cuttack (Charitatola)
quote: 康寧哈姆比定爲 Caritrapura,指現今浦里(Puri)城…有一南德拉(Nendra)村,村外還有古代港口遺址可尋…以上兩說各有所長,孰是孰非,尚待進一步的研究
note: Same as Mizutani (Puri or Nendra).

identification: N Ganjam district, Orissa, by Chilka lake; capital Jaugada, 18 miles NW of Ganjam town (Takakuwa)
others_reported: Fergusson: near Bhubaneswar; Takakuwa: Jaugada; other site Keśarapalle (Goomsur)
quote: 古代碑銘考定爲 Kongoda…其地卽今奥里薩邦的甘賈姆(Ganjam)縣北部…考定為現今甘賈姆市西北十八英里處的喬羯…因此我們傾向於高桑氏的考證
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: between the Mahānadī and the Godāvarī; capital undecided
others_reported: Cunningham: Rājamahendri; Fergusson: Kalingapatam; Smith, Majumdar: Mukhalingam; Takakuwa: Srikakulam
quote: 大抵北起馬納底河,南抵哥達瓦里河…上述各種異議孰是孰非是十分困難的
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Mahendragiri; the stone stūpa ruin still stands, with inscriptions of Rājendra Chola
quote: 大山嶺上有石窣堵波:大山嶺或馬德拉山…本段中所記的高百餘尺的石塔遺址,至今尚存
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Skt. Kosala; Life 南憍薩羅
identification: Dakṣiṇa Kosala; capital undecided
others_reported: Cunningham: Chanda; Takakuwa: Chandrapur (Bhāndak); Fergusson: Wairagarh; Adachi: Kanker; recent: Sirpur, 37 miles SE (B.C. Law: NE) of Raipur
quote: 關於憍薩羅國國都的比定,異說很多…近年又有人比定為瓦爾達河南賴依浦爾(Raipur)東南三十七英里處的希爾浦爾(Sirpur)
note: Mizutani gives Sirpur as the recent view; Ji lists it without choosing and says Law wrote NE for SE.

name_in_source: Skt. Bhramaragiri; Faxian 波羅越 (Pārāvata < parvata); Tāranātha Śrīparvata
identification: undecided
others_reported: Beal: Dewala and Winjhasani hills (rejected); Burgess: Śrīśailam S of the Krishna; recent: Nāgārjunakoṇḍa
quote: 認為不僅山名與西藏文獻中所記的 Sriparvata一致…定爲克里希那河中流右岸的龍樹山 (Nāgārjunakonda) 古寺院遺址
note: Same as Mizutani in substance (Nāgārjunakoṇḍa as a proposal).

identification: Veṅgī kingdom between the Godāvarī and the Krishna; capital near Pedda Vegi and Cinna Vegi, 6 miles NW of Ellore (Takakuwa)
others_reported: Cunningham: Elgandel (rejected); Takakuwa: Vegi
quote: 目前大多數人同意高桑駒吉氏所比定的地方,即以現今艾洛爾(Ellore-Eluru) 西北六英里處 Pedda(大)Vegi 及Cinna(小)Vegi兩村附近
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Dhānakaṭaka; Skt. Dhānyakaṭaka; inscr. Dhaṃñakaṭaka, Dhanakaṭaka
identification: capital at Amarāvatī/Dharanikota, S bank of the Krishna
others_reported: Cunningham: Dharanikota; Fergusson, Watters, Smith, Hori: Bezwada; Burgess: Bezwada in Xuanzang's time; Sewell (Boswell): Bezwada caves
quote: 因此比定柏兹瓦達馬馱那羯磔迦城的說法難於成立…綜上所述,我們也贊同比定該國都城在今阿馬拉瓦底城附近
note: Same as Mizutani; Ji argues from inscriptions and the Wuxiang jing 熟穀 city S of the 'dark' river (after Takakuwa).

identification: site of the Amarāvatī great stūpa
others_reported: Sewell: caves on the hill E of Bezwada; Burgess: Bezwada stūpa (both rejected)
quote: 該寺被比定為阿馬拉瓦底(Amarayati)西南之著名大塔的所在地
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Dharanikota, 1 mile W of Amarāvatī
others_reported: Sewell: caves on the hill W of Bezwada (rejected)
quote: 該寺被比定在阿馬拉瓦底西方一英里的馱羅尼廓吒(Dharanikotta)
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: the large hill 2 miles SE of Amarāvatī, with ancient finds
others_reported: Sewell: Undavalli cave temples near Bezwada (rejected with the Bezwada theory)
quote: 認為該市附近的翁大威力(Undavalli)石窟殿堂即是玄奘下文所記的…阿馬拉瓦底城東南二英里有大山丘,發現過不少古代文物
note: Differs from Mizutani, who gives no identification.

name_in_source: Skt. Colya, Coḍa, Cola; Tamil Sola
identification: a small Telugu-Cola holding on the lower Penner; capital Nellore (Fergusson)
others_reported: Julien: Coromandel; Lassen: misplaced in the text; Cunningham: Karnul (Jorampur); Fergusson: Nellore; Smith: Cuddapah
quote: 其領域在南印度東岸佩內爾(Penner)河下游…所以唯一合理的解釋只能是此國是注輦人的一個小領地…在上述三種說法中,我們贊同費格遜的意見
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Tamil country centred on the Palar; capital Kāñcīpura = Conjeeveram, 43 miles SW of Madras
others_reported: Cunningham: Conjeeveram; Fergusson: Nagapattinam (rejected)
quote: 斯西南四十三英里帕拉爾河北岸的康契維臘姆(Conjeeveram)…主張建志補羅城為那伽鉢那(Nagapatam)…這樣立論未免片面,我們不表贊同
note: Same as Mizutani.

name_in_source: Skt. Malakūṭa < Tamil Malaikoṭṭa or Malaikuṟṟam; 枳秣羅 = Kumārī (Beal)
identification: Pāṇḍya country (Kaveri and Vaigai basins); capital Madurai; known to Xuanzang only by report
others_reported: Beal: Kumārī; Aiyer (1917): Malainādu
quote: 目前較為可信的定是此國卽潘底亞…折向西北赴恭建那補羅國巡禮,并未親臨秣羅矩吒國…潘地亞國都馬杜拉(Madura),在韋蓋河
note: Same as Mizutani on capital; Ji stresses that Xuanzang did not visit.

identification: the Cardamom range, S end of the Western Ghats from the Nilgiris to Cape Comorin
others_reported: some: Candaka hill of the Jātaka
quote: 卽西高止山從尼爾山(Nilgiris)直抵科摩林角(Cape Comorin)那段稱為卡爾達蒙(Cardamon)的山脈
note: Same as Mizutani.

identification: Papanasam hill, Tinnevelly district (8°43'N, 77°22'E), E of the Malaya
quote: 此山被比定為現今西高止山南段,秣刺耶山以東的巴波那桑(Papanasam)山
note: Firmer than Mizutani, who allows the mountain may be legendary.

identification: Nāgapaṭṭinam at the Kaveri mouth
others_reported: Takakuwa: Rāmnād (judged weak)
quote: 位於科弗里(Kaveri)河口,與斯里蘭卡隔海相望…比定臘姆納德(Rāmnād)爲布呾落迦山東北海畔之城。我們認為他的論據比較薄弱
note: Same as Mizutani (Nāgapaṭṭinam as the crossing port).
